title: cenchrus mezianus
intro: Cenchrus mezianus, commonly known as Broom Grass, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Cenchrus mezianus are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
